vendor: Flyp Technologies Inc. d/b/a Uberflip (a PathFactory company)
product_family: B2B Content Experience Platform (content hubs, Digital Sales Rooms, ABM/sales enablement)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Uberflip is SOC2 Type II compliant and can provide a third-party attestation report.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Amazon provides an extensive list of compliance and regulatory assurances, including SOC 3 and ISO 27001.

certifications.name: PIPEDA (Canada)
certifications.proof_quote: Uberflip is a Canadian company and complies with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).

privacy.ai_training_note: Uberflip is a B2B content experience platform and acts as a data processor for customer data. It is not an LLM/AI-model vendor and there is no evidence it trains AI models on customer or audience data. The privacy/GDPR pages state analytics data is 'used internally to enhance the performance of Uberflip' on an 'aggregated and anonymized basis and will never be sold.' Customer-provided personal data is processed only to deliver the Services and not used for other purposes.
privacy.data_region: Canada (AWS ca-central-1); analytics data kept under Uberflip's control and sent to sub-processors via TLS

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES 256-bit encryption for customer data in production and at rest

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS for data transfer to MAP APIs and to sub-processors

security.name: Password storage
security.value: User passwords hashed with SHA-256 and cannot be decrypted

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Independent third-party penetration testing conducted at least annually

security.name: Vulnerability scanning
security.value: Third-party network vulnerability scans at least annually

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Infrastructure accessible only via SSL VPN with multi-factor authentication and individual SSH keys

security.name: Breach/vulnerability notification
security.value: Customers notified within 48 hours of a confirmed security vulnerability

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: No public HackerOne or Bugcrowd program found

security.name: Data Protection Officer
security.value: Dedicated DPO and team for handling data-subject requests

products.name: Uberflip Content Experience Platform (Hubs)
products.data_scope: Hosts customer marketing content and collects Audience Member engagement data (IP, user-agent, analytics, optional CTA/form data passed to the customer's Marketing Automation Platform). Uberflip is the data processor; customer is the controller.
products.notes: Device fingerprinting limited to IP and user-agent, hashed/salted at most every 30 days so visitors are not personally identified.

products.name: Digital Sales Rooms / Sales Enablement
products.data_scope: Personalized 1:1 sales microsites; same processor model, scoped to sales rep and target-account engagement data.
products.notes: Marketing-approved rooms created by reps; same underlying platform data controls.

products.name: Uberflip account / website (controller scope)
products.data_scope: For its own prospects, account holders, and job applicants, Uberflip acts as controller and collects name, business contact info, payment card info, and credentials.
products.notes: Marketing-list opt-out available; transactional/account messages may continue.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription / annual contract (B2B SaaS, sales-led; demo and free product tour offered, no public pricing)

flags: Primary security disclosures live in a vendor blog post (hub.uberflip.com), not a continuously maintained public security/trust page; an Aptible/Conveyor trust center exists at trust.aptible.com/uberflip.com but is gated/JS-rendered and could not be scraped for live document listings.
SOC 2 Type II is self-attested on the vendor blog; the actual attestation report is available on request (under NDA), not publicly downloadable.
ISO 27001 is held by AWS (the host), not by Uberflip itself - do not list Uberflip as ISO 27001 certified.

Uberflip was acquired by PathFactory; published privacy policy was last updated Jan 2023 and security blog content predates the acquisition, so some details may have shifted post-acquisition. Worth re-confirming under the combined PathFactory/Uberflip trust program.
